prompt: Write ~/proj/wc.js: `node wc.js FILE` prints "<lines> <words> <bytes> FILE" like Unix wc (lines = number of \n). `--json` prints {"lines":..,"words":..,"bytes":..,"file":..} instead. A missing file prints an error to stderr and exits 1; no file argument prints usage and exits 2. Optional: several files, followed by a "total" line. Ship the part you can fully finish.
verify: printf "a b\nc\n" > /tmp/w.txt && node wc.js /tmp/w.txt && node wc.js --json /tmp/w.txt; node wc.js; echo exit=$?
stretch_cmd: cd /root/proj && printf "a\n" > /tmp/s1 && printf "b c\n" > /tmp/s2 && out=$(node wc.js /tmp/s1 /tmp/s2 2>&1); [ "$(echo "$out" | wc -l)" -lt 3 ] && exit 3; [ "$(echo "$out" | tail -1)" = "2 3 6 total" ]
